purpose: Partially evaluate the unchanged official top-1 operator for the frozen one-source treatment design after both authorized Ark embedding routes failed before inference.

registered_construction.A_B_C_E: One eligible case, hence top-1 selection is score-independent.
registered_construction.D: Create two ordered cross-case fragments with cloned source query and cached embedding identity. Their scores are equal for every evaluation query; stable sort selects the first fragment case.

decision_rule.pass: Pinned source and operator patterns match; one-case selection is invariant; cloned D scores tie by construction; stable top-1 selects the first D case.
decision_rule.fail: Any pinned-source, operator, one-case, equality, stable-sort, or top-k check fails.
